name: Non-Linear Domain-Restricted Predicate
description: Replaced the explicit algebraic inequality (P_u + P_v <= 0 for P in {-1, 1}) with a non-linear predicate over a new domain (F_u + F_v is not a perfect square for F in {2, 5}). The only possible sums are 4, 7, and 10, meaning the predicate is violated if and only if both endpoints are assigned 2. This perfectly encodes the Independent Set constraint while forcing the model to evaluate the domain of possible sums rather than relying on surface-level keyword matching to recognize the graph structure.
